name: Zane Regulus
source:
A tyrannical and foul-mouthed beast who's part of Libra.

He has a job as an assassin and passionately works to fulfill his revenge, but within his heart hides an almost blind love--

Organization: Libra
Fairy Tale Curse: Beauty and the Beast's Beast
